title: Fancy Pink Pear
metaDescription: Fancy Pink pear diamond pendant in 18K rose gold — the axis holds the colour, the rose gold matches it. GIA certified. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Fancy pink is a geological accident — nitrogen arranged under the right pressure, over the right time, in the right conditions. The pear shape was chosen deliberately: its axis gives the color a direction, so the warmth concentrates at the tip and opens toward the shoulder as the stone moves. The rose gold setting reads the same color temperature as the diamond. The piece exists to hold the color.
